config.name: cardiac_quadratic_reference_quadrature8_v1
config.scope: Prospective full-cycle integration-sensitivity control after P2 residual verification. Compare against completed coarse P2/GAMG/1.25ms/degree6 from rest. Only source volume/facet quadrature degree changes to8; same geometry, displacement space, passive law, loading, solver and physical acceptance criteria. Nonpolynomial HGO stress requires an integration check independent of mesh/timestep sensitivity. Apply the same declared1% space-time displacement sensitivity threshold. This is a one-case numerical control, not continuum truth or a neural model-selection result.

kinematics_verification: Affine-field determinant and volume integral verified independently against native UFL; actual-field integral checks are recorded in native_integral_checked_steps.
positivity_scope: Source degree-6 quadrature points and all tetrahedral vertices, endpoint and generalized-alpha stress states; not a mathematical positivity guarantee between sample locations.
